title: Refraction of Light

sections.heading: 1. Snell's Law & Refractive Index
sections.proseLatex: $n = \sin i / \sin r$. Light speed in medium $= c/n$.

sections.heading: 2. Total Internal Reflection
sections.proseLatex: TIR occurs when going from denser to rarer medium at angle $>\theta_c = \sin^{-1}(n_2/n_1)$.

keyFormulas.label: Critical Angle
keyFormulas.aiExplainContext: Threshold angle for total internal reflection.

workedExamples.problemLatex: Find critical angle for glass-air interface ($n = 1.5$).

wbjeebTraps: Optical fibres use TIR for light guidance.
